title: Affected test selection with deterministic labels
summary: Given the src files a real commit changed, select the test modules that execute code in them. Labels come from per-module call tracing at the case file's base commit, with no model involved (DEC-0006). A case passes on recall 1.0 with precision >= 0.5. Deterministic routes (deterministic:import-graph, deterministic:all-tests) compete with model routes.
